source_records.title: JRC Reference Data from Experiments on Onboard Hydrogen Tanks Fast Filling
source_records.observed_public_scope: The record describes measured pressure and temperature histories and reports that reference data were intended for safety and CFD validation.

source_records.title: JRC reference data from experiments of onboard hydrogen tanks fast filling
source_records.observed_public_scope: The record exposes publication metadata and experimental description; its Datasets and Dataset collections sections do not expose a public raw time-series URL.

source_records.title: Hydrogen tank first filling experiments at the JRC-IET GasTeF facility
source_records.observed_public_scope: The record describes full-scale tank tests and instrumentation but does not expose a machine-readable synchronized raw trace.

hytransfer_archived_site_recheck.interpretation: The preserved HYTRANSFER download page exposes reports, slides and images, including the public filling-campaign report, but no CSV, XLSX, ZIP or other machine-readable GasTeF trace archive.

claim_boundary: The official records support provenance for GasTeF instrumentation and filling experiments. They do not provide an independently reusable time-resolved trace for numerical validation, station-to-vehicle full-loop validation or site-safety claims.
next_action: Use the existing data request draft to request a de-identified raw export, channel dictionary, calibration metadata and written reuse permission. Freeze the holdout protocol before opening numerical outcomes.
